### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is Jules Verne considered a science fiction author?**
A: While his works often feature elements of speculative technology, Jules Verne is generally categorized as an adventure novelist whose stories heavily anticipated scientific and exploratory concepts.

**Q: Are the adventures set on Earth or in space?**
A: His narratives span all continents of the Earth, with some famous titles even taking readers into outer space.
